comments.comment: Static unpacking and Go capability mapping, 2026-10-25 UTC. SHA-256 verified; this 3,593,216-byte PE statically decompresses with trusted UPX to a8fa709080a93280094b008801ed390ef705414feb24aa7608e8b72ee1860d4c (12,570,112 bytes), matching the separately indexed unpacked MalwareBazaar record exactly. The unpacked file is native Go/PE32 rather than a CLI assembly. Its 32-bit Go pclntab recovers 10,636 function entries. Application names/addresses include main.Steal 0x8e5b30, main.GetChromiumMasterKeys 0x8f8090, main.GetGeckoMasterKey 0x8f5da0, main.DPAPI 0x8f97b0, main.GetAppBoundKey 0x8fcc30, main.findLsassProcess 0x8f8de0, main.getSystemToken 0x8f9300, main.impersonateSystem 0x8f9660 and salat/screenshot.Capture 0x738120. Browser database markers include Login Data, Local State, Web Data, Cookies, key4.db and logins.json. This supports the upstream SalatStealer label but does not establish successful credential recovery on a host. Network setup main.initConnection 0x8d4220 calls main.getEp 0x8d3a30 before net/url.Parse. Main.tonResolve 0x8dfee0 and main.decodeFromTonAddress 0x8de0e0 are present; the latter has 64/66-character hex-decoding paths. This bounded review did not recover a verified final C2 endpoint or establish a live TON lookup, and no blockchain query or endpoint connection was made. Credential-shaped configuration values are deliberately omitted. Shared public DNS resolvers, Go documentation links and GitHub library URLs are not C2 IOCs merely because they appear in strings. No PE/Go execution, credential API invocation, process impersonation, screenshot capture or packer-stub execution was performed; decompressed files were non-executable temporary analysis data. Packed/unpacked records are representations of the same payload, not separate campaign variants.
